Master Sergeant Max Beilke was an American hero from Minnesota who was killed on 9/11. After serving in Korea he was the last combat soldier to leave Vietnam, and was later instrumental in passing TRICARE for Life and was in a meeting on veteran issues at the Pentagon when it was attacked.

At the newly opened Minnesota Military & Veterans Museum in Little Falls, there is an exhibit dedicated to him – showing the ring he had on 25 years ago. It’s a powerful reminder of Max’s life and service.

posts.text: Scott Wallace of Woodbury survived the attack on the North Tower. He joined us today at the Minnesota Military & Veterans Museum in Little Falls.
